command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
# PATH export IS needed: aarchbio images have their PATH dropped by the task shell.
#
# This reproduces ViennaRNA's own RNAfold test exactly as tests/RNAfold/general runs it:
#   RNAfold --noPS -d <n> < rnafold.small.seq > out   then  diff -ru <gold> out
# A BYTE-EXACT whole-file comparison over 50 sequences, not a single MFE value -- so every
# structure and every energy in the file has to match, in seven different modes.

echo "== staged bytes must match their pins =="
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: a staged file does not match its pin"; exit 1; }

echo "== the binary version must match the golds' release =="
RNAfold --version | tee ver.txt
grep -q "RNAfold 2.7.2" ver.txt || {
  echo "FAIL: this is not RNAfold 2.7.2; the gold files are version-specific"; exit 1; }

PASS=0; FAIL=0
run_mode() {
  label="$1"; gold="$2"; shift 2
  RNAfold --noPS "$@" < rnafold.small.seq > "out.$label" 2> "err.$label"
  rc=$?
  if [ "$rc" != "0" ]; then
    printf 'mode\t%-6s RNAfold exited %s\n' "$label" "$rc"; tail -5 "err.$label"; FAIL=$((FAIL+1)); return
  fi
  if diff -q "$gold" "out.$label" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    printf 'mode\t%-6s byte-identical to %s\n' "$label" "$gold"; PASS=$((PASS+1))
  else
    printf 'mode\t%-6s DIFFERS from %s\n' "$label" "$gold"
    diff -u "$gold" "out.$label" | head -12
    FAIL=$((FAIL+1))
  fi
}

echo "== four dangling-end treatments, --noLP, two temperatures =="
for d in 0 1 2 3; do run_mode "d$d" "rnafold.small.d$d.mfe.gold" -d "$d"; done
run_mode "noLP" rnafold.small.noLP.mfe.gold --noLP
for T in 25 40; do run_mode "T$T" "rnafold.small.T$T.mfe.gold" -T "$T"; done

printf 'modes_passed\t%s\n' "$PASS"
printf 'modes_failed\t%s\n' "$FAIL"
test "$PASS" = "7" || { echo "FAIL: only $PASS of 7 modes reproduced their gold byte-for-byte"; exit 1; }
test "$FAIL" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: $FAIL modes differ"; exit 1; }
printf 'reference\tall 7 modes byte-identical to ViennaRNA committed golds\n'

# ---------------------------------------------------------- structural identities, gold-free
# Dot-bracket is a balanced-parenthesis language and the structure spans the sequence, so for
# every record: brackets balance, never go negative, and |structure| == |sequence|. These hold
# whatever the golds say, so they survive a version bump that changes the predictions.
awk '
  /^[ACGUNacgun]+$/ { seq=$0; seqlen=length($0); next }
  /^[.()]/ {
    st=$1; n++
    if (length(st) != seqlen) { printf "FAIL: record %d structure %d chars vs sequence %d\n", n, length(st), seqlen; bad++ }
    depth=0; mind=0
    for (i=1; i<=length(st); i++) {
      ch=substr(st,i,1)
      if (ch=="(") depth++
      else if (ch==")") depth--
      if (depth<mind) mind=depth
    }
    if (depth != 0) { printf "FAIL: record %d brackets unbalanced (net %d)\n", n, depth; bad++ }
    if (mind  < 0) { printf "FAIL: record %d closes before opening\n", n; bad++ }
  }
  END{
    printf "structures_checked\t%d\n", n+0
    printf "structures_malformed\t%d\n", bad+0
    if (n < 40) { printf "FAIL: only %d structures parsed, expected 50\n", n; exit 1 }
    if (bad+0 > 0) exit 1
  }' out.d2 | tee structural.tsv
test "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: structural identity violated"; exit 1; }
printf 'identity_structure\tbrackets balance and span the sequence in every record\n'

# The modes must actually differ from each other on this input, or seven green diffs would be
# seven copies of one check.
DISTINCT=$(sha256sum out.d0 out.d1 out.d2 out.d3 out.noLP out.T25 out.T40 | awk '{print $1}' | sort -u | wc -l)
printf 'distinct_outputs\t%s of 7\n' "$DISTINCT"
test "$DISTINCT" = "7" || { echo "FAIL: only $DISTINCT distinct outputs; the modes are not being exercised"; exit 1; }

{ printf 'observable\tvalue\n'
  printf 'rnafold_version\t%s\n' "$(cat ver.txt)"
  printf 'modes_passed\t%s\n' "$PASS"
  printf 'distinct_outputs\t%s\n' "$DISTINCT"
  cat structural.tsv
  printf 'first_mfe_d2\t%s\n' "$(sed -n '2p' out.d2 | awk '{print $NF}')"
  printf 'first_mfe_d0\t%s\n' "$(sed -n '2p' out.d0 | awk '{print $NF}')"
} > score.tsv
cp score.tsv viennarna-diag.txt
uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo "VIENNARNA OK"
